subject: general
question: Choose the correct statement from the given options. The press is a democracy must:

options.text: highlight the achievements of the government without criticising its policies
be committed to the policies of the government
criticise the policies of the government

solution:
Correct answer is __**be free and impartial.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The press in democracy must- · be free and impartial.
 
• Be perform to the **policies of the government.**
 
• Media democracy provides people the right to take part in media.
 
• The backbone of any democracy is an** independent, executive and responsible media.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/822a7de57ea52d4c4406ea79cce028409ba60e7ba8ff396a25448b9ad3b7f349.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​****Freedom of press or media **mentions to the rights given by the Constitution of India under the freedom and expression of speech in **Article 19(1)(a).**
 
• The law of India forbid increasing or publishing** fake news **through social or mass media, and could guide to** imprisonment of a journalist or newspaper ban.**** **
